diagnosis: In the first and third rollouts, the model settled on transfers and reassignments without needing the hidden information provided by PF2 and PF3. Specifically, C5 passed because the model included a 90-day no-direct-supervision period, which is directly linked to PF2. Similarly, C6 passed in the second and fourth rollouts due to the inclusion of Audit Committee notice, which is linked to PF3.

C5.why: PF2 changes the resolution from leaving the reporting relationship unspecified to transferring the complainant to Product Compliance under the Chief Compliance Officer with exactly 90 days of no direct supervision.

C6.why: PF3 changes the closure package by requiring Audit Committee notice before closure, a requirement not established by the ordinary investigation facts.
